cards.back: An inequality that contains an absolute value expression, such as $ |x| < 2 $ or $ |x| > 2 $.
Rewrite as a compound 'and' inequality: $ -c < x < c $. The solution is the [[imp:intersection]] of two inequalities.
cards.front: How do you solve $ |x| < c $ for $ c > 0 $?
How do you solve $ |x| > c $ for $ c > 0 $?
cards.back: Rewrite as a compound 'or' inequality: $ x < -c $ or $ x > c $. The solution is the [[imp:union]] of two inequalities.

cards.front: What mnemonic helps remember 'and' vs 'or' for absolute value inequalities?

cards.back: Write $ -2 \le x + 7 \le 2 $. Subtract 7: $ -9 \le x \le -5 $. Graph: closed circles at -9 and -5, shade between.

cards.front: What happens if an absolute value inequality has a negative right side, like $ |x| < -3 $?
cards.back: [[imp:No solution]]. Absolute value is never negative, so it can't be less than a negative number.

cards.front: What happens if an absolute value inequality has a negative right side, like $ |x| > -3 $?
cards.back: [[imp:All real numbers]] are solutions. Absolute value is always $ \ge 0 $, which is greater than any negative number.
Write $ c - 1 \le -5 $ or $ c - 1 \ge 5 $. Add 1: $ c \le -4 $ or $ c \ge 6 $. Graph: closed circles at -4 and 6, shade outward.

cards.front: What must you do before applying the compound inequality rule for absolute value?
cards.back: [[imp:Isolate the absolute value expression]] on one side of the inequality. Then write the appropriate compound inequality.
Subtract 1, divide by 4: $ |2x - 5| > 5 $. Write $ 2x - 5 < -5 $ or $ 2x - 5 > 5 $. Solve: $ x < 0 $ or $ x > 5 $.
Subtract 5: $ -3|2 - 4u| < -18 $. Divide by -3 and reverse < to >: $ |2 - 4u| > 6 $. Then $ 2 - 4u < -6 $ or $ 2 - 4u > 6 $ → $ u > 2 $ or $ u < -1 $.
The absolute value of the difference between a number $ x $ and a given value: $ |x - \text{given value}| $. It measures how far $ x $ is from the target.
$ |x - 664| \le 100 $ → $ -100 \le x - 664 \le 100 $ → $ 564 \le x \le 764 $. Acceptable prices are between $564 and $764.
cards.front: A computer's mean price is $664. You'll pay within $100 of the mean. Write and solve the absolute value inequality.

cards.back: Same as < and >: $ \le $ uses 'and' with $ -c \le ax+b \le c $; $ \ge $ uses 'or' with $ ax+b \le -c $ or $ ax+b \ge c $. The boundary points are included (closed circles).
cards.front: How do you solve an absolute value inequality with $ \le $ or $ \ge $?
What is the blueprint for solving absolute value inequalities?
cards.back: [[imp:Understand]]: Identify < (and) or > (or); isolate if needed; check right side sign. [[imp:Solve]]: Write compound inequality and solve. [[imp:Conclude]]: Graph and check solution.
